project.title: Db2 Privacy Copilot
project.short_description: A Db2-connected privacy operations demo for finding personal-data candidates, managing consent history, and preparing reviewable data-rights plans with human approval and deterministic SQL guardrails.

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker), verified with Db2 12.1.5.0
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db / ibm_db_dbi; LangChain langchain-db2 DB2VS integration
features_used: SYSCAT catalog metadata for schema discovery
Bitemporal consent table and history table
Db2 vector search for privacy taxonomy embeddings
Db2-backed request and SHA-256 audit records

ai_models: Local Sentence Transformers embeddings; no hosted LLM provider is configured by default
